How hot should you drink your coffee? 



Tim Cross

Senior science writer



 I’m writing this with a delicious, carcinogenic cup of tea steaming on my desk. It is carcinogenic at the moment because it’s freshly made and the water is hot. And according to a much-covered study published on September 8th, hot drinks are bad for your throat.

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Macro still owns the tape — bitcoin sits near $77K with a Fed hike all but priced in. Underneath it, Washington moves on crypto tax rules while security failures and political money take the headlines. 🏛️ House Tax Panel Sets First-Ever Vote on Crypto Tax Rules The House Ways and Means Committee has scheduled a September 16 markup on a package of digital asset tax bills — the first time crypto tax legislation has reached a formal committee vote. H.R. 9175 would let miners and stakers defer income on newly created tokens until they are sold, while H.R. 9172 would extend stock-style wash-sale rules to digital assets. A favourable vote sends the package to the full House floor. Read full story 🔓 Revolut Handed Over Passports and Bitcoin Histories to a Fake Government Request The fintech fulfilled a fraudulent information request sent from a government agency's own email domain, exposing ID documents, selfies, home addresses and full crypto transaction histories for a limited number of users. No customer funds were lost, but the breach underlines how KYC archives have become one of the richest targets in the industry. More details 🇬🇧 Farage's Reform UK Lands $97M From Two Crypto Billionaires Nigel Farage's Reform UK took in roughly $97 million from two crypto billionaires inside 24 hours, a combined haul that equals the largest individual political donations in British history. It marks a sharp escalation of crypto industry political funding well beyond the United States. Read more 📉 Fed Hike All but Assured, Leaving Bitcoin Pinned Below $80K After core CPI came in at a faster-than-forecast 0.3% for August, traders have moved to price a September 16 rate increase as the base case. Bitcoin is holding around $77,000 with Treasury yields at multi-decade highs, and US spot bitcoin ETFs have now strung together several consecutive sessions of net outflows. See details 💵 Ripple Eyes a $13 Trillion Corporate Treasury Market for RLUSD Ripple stablecoin chief Jack McDonald says payments and capital markets are driving growth for the $2.4 billion RLUSD, and puts the corporate treasury opportunity at $13 trillion. The company is preparing to bring the digital dollar to Europe under MiCA.
